newsitem.title: GREECE: SCHEDULE OF GREEK CORPORATE BRIEFINGS TO FUNDS.
newsitem.headline: SCHEDULE OF GREEK CORPORATE BRIEFINGS TO FUNDS.

text.p: Corporate briefings to Greek
institutional investors by Athens bourse listings will continue
with St George Mills , a flour mill, and Sportsman, a sportswear retailer, set for Wednesday Apr 23, 1997.
The presentations are part of a series of briefings on
corporate prospects and business plans of listed Greek companies
which are held on a weekly basis in Athens at Greece's
Association of Institutional Investors.
A total of 37 Greek listed companies have come under the
scrutiny of Greek institutional investors since Dec 18, 1996.
Around 30 more companies are slated for a presentation in
the coming months, an association official told Reuters.
The schedule for the coming weeks has as follows:
Apr 23, 1997 St George Mills
Sportsman
May 7, 1997 Yalco
Mytilineos
General Commerce
May 14, 1997 Viohalko
Hellenic Cables
--Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301-3311812-4
